The reference dataset now includes annual operatingCost and depreciation totals for 1403-1417 transcribed from pages 24-27. These are source schedule rows only and are not engine outputs.

Page 24 itemized operating cost totals for 1403 (53,466,973.84) and 1405 (66,206,503.67) differ from discounted cash-flow page 57 (53,459,511.66 for 1403) and recurring operating-cost rows (66,205,570.90 for 1405). Preserve both as source discrepancies; do not overwrite or force parity.

Pages 57-61 were re-read and normalized into 75 annual reference rows for 1403-1417: total cash inflow, total cash outflow, corporate income tax, net cash flow and net working-capital change. Values retain their printed report pages and million-Rial units.

Pages 57-61 are discounted cash flow summaries. The transcribed net cash flow is the report's printed line and must not be treated as an engine-calculated operating cash flow or as proof of financial-statement parity.

Working-capital changes are explicitly printed as 2,393,498.33 (1403), 283,357.28 (1404), 283,590.29 (1405), -33.29 (1406), and 0.00 in 1407-1417; zeroes are retained only where the source explicitly prints zero.

Page 55 annual schedule was transcribed for 1403-1417 into 60 income-statement reference rows: foreign sales, domestic sales, foreign production costs and domestic production costs. The report prints foreign sales as zero in all listed years and foreign production costs as zero from 1412 onward; explicit zeroes are retained.

Page 2 summary income statement anchor values were transcribed for 1403, 1405 and 1417 (54 rows), including sales, operating costs, depreciation, financing costs, total production costs, marketing, cost of products, gross operating profit, taxable profit, income tax and net profit.

Cross-check: page 55 domestic plus foreign reported production-cost components sum exactly to page 2 cost of products for the three anchor years: 1403 = 56,100,198.97; 1405 = 67,892,594.02; 1417 = 66,284,570.90 (million Rial). Therefore page 55 cost components are recorded as cost-of-products components, not as operatingCost. Page 2 operatingCost remains a distinct P&L line.

Page 2 operatingCost and page 24/57 annual operating cost schedules can differ slightly; these are retained as separate source lines with page provenance. No attempt has been made to force these schedules to agree.
Observed effective tax ratios differ by year: 1403 and 1405 summary tax are about 5% of taxable profit, while 1417 is 25%. No single tax rate is inferred from these anchor rows.

Page 2 arithmetic check: taxable profit minus corporate income tax equals net profit for 1403 (7,099,801.03 - 354,990.05 = 6,744,810.98) and 1405 (11,107,405.98 - 555,370.30 = 10,552,035.68). For 1417 the subtraction gives 9,536,571.83 while the printed net profit is 9,536,571.82, a 0.01 million-Rial rounding difference retained as printed.

Page 24 operating cost (factory operating cost) differs from the page 2 summary P&L operating cost: 1403 page 24 = 53,466,973.84 vs page 2 = 53,459,511.66; 1405 page 24 = 66,206,503.67 vs page 2 = 66,205,570.90. Page 57 discounted cash flow also reports 53,459,511.66 in 1403. These schedule-specific values remain separately traceable; no overwrite or assumed correction.

Tax schedule observations: the page 2 effective tax ratios at anchor years are approximately 5% (1403), 5% (1405), and 25% (1417). Pages 57-61 show the annual cash-flow tax line, but do not by themselves expose the complete taxable-income bridge, loss carryforward, exemptions or rate-change assumptions. Therefore the underlying tax policy remains unresolved.
